author: Zach
description: Deadlock (Valve) player profile/rank lookup, match history, hero and item win-rate analytics, regional leaderboards, Steam account linking, and a per-server configurable patch-note/news poller backed by deadlock-api.com and Valve's Steam news feed.
short: Deadlock player stats, hero/item analytics, leaderboards, and patch-note news.
name: Deadlock
install_msg: Thanks for installing Deadlock! Run `[p]help Deadlock` to get started. Optionally set a deadlock-api.com key for higher rate limits with `[p]set api deadlockapi api_key,<key>`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the Discord user ID and linked Deadlock/Steam account ID of users who opt in via the account-link command, and per-server configuration (channels, feature toggles, watermarks) for server administrators. No message content is stored.
